notes.title: Quality of Life Update
notes.content:
Hey Everyone, the Demo for Tape 101 received a quality of life update which will be in the following:



Re-Worked Dialogue: 

The dialogue system has been re-worked, therefore you can now read & skip to the next dialogue with LMB "Left Mouse Button".



Optimization:

We have optimized the game to run on older rigs for a better & smoother experience, the game now can run on high-ultra settings on an NVIDIA GTX 1650 targeting 50-60 FPS.



Thank you guys for sticking around.

-Suversa, Double H Productions

notes.title: Demo Patch Notes-1
notes.content:
Hey everyone, we hope you are enjoying the Demo.
The following section are the patch notes for the update that we have uploaded, also keep in mind that this version will receive more future updates alongside localisation, more will be talked about later.

Patch Notes:

-Updated Disclaimer Interaction: Replaced the “Accept & Continue” button with a “Click Anywhere” interaction on the Disclaimer page for a smoother user experience.

-Audio Overlap Fix: Resolved an issue where Dr. Domoradzki’s dialogue (the scientist on the PC) overlapped with Dr. Sam David’s voice lines.

-Extended Dialogue Display: Increased the on-screen duration of Dr. Sam David’s dialogue in the operation room area from 5 seconds to 8 seconds for better readability.

-Enhanced Running Sound Variants: Added 9 new footstep sound effects during running, increasing the total from 5 to 14. This makes the running audio feel more dynamic, varied, and natural.

-Relocated Dr. John's Note: Moved the note to a more accessible and linear location to ensure players don’t miss it during gameplay.



One more thing, guys report any bugs, suggest feedback in the community hub section or join our Discord server, thank you!

-Double H Productions
